integrity: Claims proved by a self-contained local transition/census argument and supported by two different finite checkers; no claim of independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Only binary synchronous open-neighbor strict majority with tie retention on K1 joined with r disjoint triangles, r>=1. No statement for other clique sizes or updates; historical unindexed priority remains possible.
title: Four-step majority dynamics and exact oscillation basins on triangular clique windmills
